name: Biwako Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of Lake Biwa, Japan's largest lake, with the Hira mountains, the Karasaki pine shore and the Omi lakefront scenery.
notes: Managed by Shiga/Kyoto. The lake cruise and the Hikone castle shore are the draws.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
businessHours: Open access (park; facility hours vary by season and area)
